# RC44 — Matching bracket navigation

Date: 2026-07-28

Workspace: `/path/to/wscrpt`

Git: not a Git repository in this workspace; checkpoint identity is the source tree at this path plus the artifacts below.

## Change

- Added `Esc g m` / `core.matching-bracket` / `Go to Matching Bracket`.
- The command jumps between local `()`, `[]`, and `{}` bracket pairs in the active buffer.
- It checks the character under the cursor first, then the previous character, so it works when the cursor is on or immediately after a bracket.
- The scan handles nested pairs, moves the cursor to the matching bracket, records jump history, and reports a visible no-match status.
- The README navigation table, command palette, keymap reference, action footer, and iPad QA now expose the route.
